each-query.says: Every query of the vocabulary (the derivations, lenses, views, labels, questions and table queries), asked of a copy of the pod a fresh import left: on the reference engine over the pod's own statements and, for the ones that have a SQL version, in SQL on a database holding the same statements, with what each gave compared.
each-query.total: Filling the reference engine and a database from the pod's statements, making every view's screen, and asking every query of the vocabulary once on the reference engine and, where it has one, in SQL.

measures.reference-load: Filling the reference engine's store with the pod's statements, read from the pod's own database, so that both engines read the same statements.
measures.database-load: Filling a database with the same statements and making every view's screen in it: the work that a SQL version of a view or a question stands on.

measureFamilies.says: The time the reference engine takes to answer {name} over the whole pod.
The time the pod's database takes to answer {name} in SQL.
The time the pod's database takes to give the first page of 20 entries of {name}.
How many rows the reference engine gave for {name}, with a fingerprint of them.
1 when the SQL version of {name} gave the same rows as the reference engine, 0 when it did not; the note says how the rows differ, or why the SQL version gave none.
The reference engine took longer than its limit of 60 seconds for {name}; the value is the limit in seconds. It is not stopped at the limit, so its time and rows are in the rows of the same name.
{name} was not asked of the pod: the note says why.

scenario.reference-load.says: Filling the reference engine's store with the pod's statements.

scenario.database-load.says: Filling a database with the pod's statements and making every view's screen.

each-query.sparql.says: One query asked of the pod on the reference engine; the calls are the queries that were asked.

each-query.sql.says: One query asked of the pod in SQL; the calls are the queries that have a SQL version, and the pages asked.

counts.queries: How many queries of the vocabulary outside the matcher there are, each asked once.
counts.with-sql: How many of them have a SQL version beside the query.
counts.without-sql: How many have none yet: every derivation, the lenses and some questions. They are answered by the reference engine alone.
counts.not-run: How many could not be asked of the pod: the table queries read reference tables the pod's database does not hold.
